overview: Durrant House is a hotel in its own grounds at Northam, near Bideford, overlooking the Taw estuary just off the A39. It has standard, family, romantic and accessible rooms, a seasonal heated outdoor pool, a spa, a fitness room, a restaurant and a bar, and free on-site parking with EV charging. Westward Ho! is a short drive away.
surfTripFit: Easy parking and full hotel facilities suit a driving surf trip, but the beach at Westward Ho! is a drive rather than a walk and there is no surfer-specific storage mentioned.
